title.fr: Crée un validateur de propriété toujours vraie

description.en: In this lab you will test a specific property of each object in an array to see if it always has a truthy value or not.
description.fr: Dans ce lab, tu vas tester une propriété précise de chaque objet dans un tableau pour voir si elle a toujours une valeur truthy ou non.

description.en: For example, you could be asked to test one property of the objects in an array like the following:
description.fr: Par exemple, on pourrait te demander de tester une propriété des objets d'un tableau comme celui-ci :

description.en: If you were asked to test the `name` property, in the objects of this array the property `name` has the values of `"Quincy"`, `"Naomi"`, and `"Camperbot"`, so it is always truthy.
description.fr: Si on te demande de tester la propriété `name`, dans les objets de ce tableau la propriété `name` a les valeurs `"Quincy"`, `"Naomi"` et `"Camperbot"`, donc elle est toujours truthy.

description.en: If you were asked to test the `role` property, the values are `"Founder"`, `""`, and `"Bot"`, in this case `""` is a falsy value, so the values are not always truthy.
description.fr: Si on te demande de tester la propriété `role`, les valeurs sont `"Founder"`, `""` et `"Bot"`. Dans ce cas, `""` est une valeur falsy, donc les valeurs ne sont pas toujours truthy.

description.en: **Objective:** Fulfill the user stories below and get all the tests to pass to complete the lab.
description.fr: **Objectif :** réalise les user stories ci-dessous et fais passer tous les tests pour terminer le lab.

description.en:
1. You should have a function named `truthCheck`.
1. The `truthCheck` function takes two arguments: an array of objects and a string representing a property name found in those objects.
1. The function should check if the property with the name equal to the second argument has a truthy value in all the objects of the array, and return `true` if it has, and `false` otherwise.
description.fr:
1. Tu dois avoir une fonction nommée `truthCheck`.
1. La fonction `truthCheck` prend deux arguments : un tableau d'objets et une chaîne représentant un nom de propriété trouvé dans ces objets.
1. La fonction doit vérifier si la propriété dont le nom est égal au second argument a une valeur truthy dans tous les objets du tableau, et renvoyer `true` si c'est le cas, ou `false` sinon.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{name: "Quincy", role: "Founder", isBot: false}, {name: "Naomi", role: "", isBot: false}, {name: "Camperbot", role: "Bot", isBot: true}], "isBot")` should return `false`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{name: "Quincy", role: "Founder", isBot: false}, {name: "Naomi", role: "", isBot: false}, {name: "Camperbot", role: "Bot", isBot: true}], "isBot")` doit renvoyer `false`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{name: "Quincy", role: "Founder", isBot: false}, {name: "Naomi", role: "", isBot: false}, {name: "Camperbot", role: "Bot", isBot: true}], "name")` should return `true`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{name: "Quincy", role: "Founder", isBot: false}, {name: "Naomi", role: "", isBot: false}, {name: "Camperbot", role: "Bot", isBot: true}], "name")` doit renvoyer `true`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{name: "Quincy", role: "Founder", isBot: false}, {name: "Naomi", role: "", isBot: false}, {name: "Camperbot", role: "Bot", isBot: true}], "role")` should return `false`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{name: "Quincy", role: "Founder", isBot: false}, {name: "Naomi", role: "", isBot: false}, {name: "Camperbot", role: "Bot", isBot: true}], "role")` doit renvoyer `false`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{name: "Pikachu", number: 25, caught: 3}, {name: "Togepi", number: 175, caught: 1}], "number")` should return `true`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{name: "Pikachu", number: 25, caught: 3}, {name: "Togepi", number: 175, caught: 1}], "number")` doit renvoyer `true`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{name: "Pikachu", number: 25, caught: 3}, {name: "Togepi", number: 175, caught: 1}, {name: "MissingNo", number: NaN, caught: 0}], "caught")` should return `false`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{name: "Pikachu", number: 25, caught: 3}, {name: "Togepi", number: 175, caught: 1}, {name: "MissingNo", number: NaN, caught: 0}], "caught")` doit renvoyer `false`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{name: "Pikachu", number: 25, caught: 3}, {name: "Togepi", number: 175, caught: 1}, {name: "MissingNo", number: NaN, caught: 0}], "number")` should return `false`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{name: "Pikachu", number: 25, caught: 3}, {name: "Togepi", number: 175, caught: 1}, {name: "MissingNo", number: NaN, caught: 0}], "number")` doit renvoyer `false`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{name: "freeCodeCamp", users: [{name: "Quincy"}, {name: "Naomi"}]}, {name: "Code Radio", users: [{name: "Camperbot"}]}, {name: "", users: []}], "users")` should return `true`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{name: "freeCodeCamp", users: [{name: "Quincy"}, {name: "Naomi"}]}, {name: "Code Radio", users: [{name: "Camperbot"}]}, {name: "", users: []}], "users")` doit renvoyer `true`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{id: 1, data: {url: "https://freecodecamp.org", name: "freeCodeCamp"}}, {id: 2, data: {url: "https://coderadio.freecodecamp.org/", name: "CodeRadio"}}, {id: null, data: {}}], "data")` should return `true`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{id: 1, data: {url: "https://freecodecamp.org", name: "freeCodeCamp"}}, {id: 2, data: {url: "https://coderadio.freecodecamp.org/", name: "CodeRadio"}}, {id: null, data: {}}], "data")` doit renvoyer `true`.

hints.en: `truthCheck([{id: 1, data: {url: "https://freecodecamp.org", name: "freeCodeCamp"}}, {id: 2, data: {url: "https://coderadio.freecodecamp.org/", name: "CodeRadio"}}, {id: null, data: {}}], "id")` should return `false`.
hints.fr: `truthCheck([{id: 1, data: {url: "https://freecodecamp.org", name: "freeCodeCamp"}}, {id: 2, data: {url: "https://coderadio.freecodecamp.org/", name: "CodeRadio"}}, {id: null, data: {}}], "id")` doit renvoyer `false`.
